F1.evidence: The declared layer is 576 --token-<uuid> paints deduplicated to 68 values: a complete achromatic ramp (neutral-00 black through ~25 grey steps to neutral-ff white) plus the translucent alpha-white.05-.8 / alpha-black.05-.6 hairline ladder and a set of saturated accent paints (lime #cbff00, blue #0099ff, violets, greens, rose). They are colour styles, not lightness ramps per hue - no hue carries an ordered ramp.

F2.evidence: Measured roles: background.page (#000), surface.menuPanel/footerBg/loginPanel, form.fieldBg (the input is transparent; the fill is measured on its wrapper div); scrim behaviour observed behind the mega-dropdowns. The gallery page's field was never measured, so no gallery surface token is published. No named raised/overlay token family exists - Framer's paints are anonymous, so roles are measured aliases only.

F3.evidence: Primary (text.ink #fff), secondary/nav (text.navInk alpha-white.80 with navInkHover full white), on-accent (action.ctaInk #000 on white pills, planCtaInk #fff on blue), placeholder (form.placeholder) are measured. No disabled text role or distinct link colour was observed - links read as ink and no disabled control is reachable signed out.

F4.evidence: Hairlines resolve through the declared alpha-white ladder (alpha-white.7/.1/.15) measured on cards, menu panel and the footer; border.focusRing is measured (#101010 ring on the white Sign up pill). There is no named default/strong border pair in the declared layer - the paints are anonymous.

F5.evidence: Default/hover/pressed measured on the white CTAs (action.ctaFill #fff, ctaHover, forced-pressed state), the hero ghost (alpha-white.1 fill), and the #0099ff Pro plan CTA (planCtaFill). Hover lifts nav ink .8→1.0. Pressed is DevTools-forced so script-applied mousedown looks are unobserved.

F6.evidence: No success/warning/danger/info roles were observed on any public surface - no validation, error, banner or alert state is reachable signed out, and the accent paints are not labelled with status semantics in the opaque uuid layer.

F7.evidence: One painted theme per stack: marketing and the community/gallery stack paint dark; /login is a separate light shell, not a second theme of the same system. No theme switcher or dark variant of the light shell exists; tokens.json carries one dark set plus theme-independent core.

F8.evidence: Families measured with fallbacks: GT Walsheim Medium 54px/500 on the hero (font.family.measured.display), Inter Variable on nav/body/CTA (measured.body), walsheim on the community stack (measured.community), Inter Variable UI on the auth shell (measured.auth); Azeret Mono and GT Walsheim presets declared in the sheets. Measured sizes/weights exist for hero, body and controls but there is no named 6-8-step scale - the type ramp is component-scoped --framer-* vars, not a published scale.

F9.evidence: No declared spacing scale exists in the harvested stylesheets - spacing is inline Framer-layout values; measured paddings/gaps are recorded per component but there is no base-unit scale to name.

F10.evidence: Radii measured per component: the 8px control/card family (hero CTA 34px pill shape, ghost button, fields, menu panel) and the pill 9999px on chips/buttons; border widths measured per component in components.md.

F11.evidence: Control heights measured: topbar 64px (desktop and mobile), hero CTA 34px, header CTA 30px, nav links 39.59px, plan cards 300px wide, credits select 250x34, gallery chips 30px, gallery Open 55x30, login field/button 30px. F12.evidence: No elevation scale was observed - the mega-dropdown panels and cards separate by surface colour and hairlines, not a named shadow ladder; no shadow tokens were harvested or measured as a system.

F13.evidence: raw/motion.json probed four pages: 17 moving elements on home (scroll reveals, marquee loops) and 101 on the gallery, with durations/easings captured into core.motion.*. Reduced-motion coverage is partial - the homepage partially honours prefers-reduced-motion while pricing, gallery and login ignore it; recorded per page.

F14.evidence: Measured layout: 64px header, 650px mega-panel, 782px hero headline, 300px plan columns, 250px selects, mobile 390px drawer. No declared breakpoint/grid token layer exists - responsive behaviour is measured at the two captured widths only.

C1.evidence: 37 components measured across chrome (header, dropdown triggers, mega-panel, logo, locale select), actions (header/hero/plan CTAs, ghost, billing switch, credits select), forms (login field, Google button, Continue submit, gallery search), the gallery index (filters, Open buttons, cards), the FAQ and the mobile drawer. C2.evidence: States beyond default captured: hover on nav links and CTAs, focus-visible on CTAs and the login field, forced pressed, the opened mega-dropdowns and the mobile drawer, the gallery search focused state. Disabled, error, loading and submitted states are absent - not fabricated.

C3.evidence: Focus-visible measured on the Sign up pill (#101010 ring, dark.color.border.focusRing) and the login work-email field; the mega-dropdown panel closes on blur so focus inside it could not be held - recorded as a gap rather than inferred.

C4.evidence: Every measured colour aliases the declared palette paint its value matches (ink→neutral-ff, navInk→alpha-white.80, planCtaFill→accent.blue, menuPanel→neutral-11...); every token carries $extensions.source and component geometry lives under core.component.* - components.md labels each colour with its token path.

P1.evidence: patterns.md covers the marketing chrome and mega-dropdowns, the hero + embedded demo, the pricing grid with its billing switch and credits selects, the community gallery index, the auth boundary card, mobile chrome and the motion/focus conventions.
